name.description: The name identifying this beacon instance (defaults to hostname if omitted).

interface.description: Network interface to use for multicast (e.g., 'eth0').

beacon_addr.description: ASM beacon group address (with optional port, e.g., '224.0.1.1:10001' or 'ff02::1:10001').

ssm_group.description: SSM group address (with optional port, e.g., '232.1.2.3:10001').

ssm_send.description: Enable SSM data sending in addition to ASM (i.e., -O).

bootstrap_addr.description: Bootstrap peer address to use when ASM is broken but SSM works.

local_addr.description: Local source address for multicast packets (e.g., '192.0.2.1').

dump_file.description: Path to periodic dump file in XML format.

program_to_launch.description: Program to run after each dump. First argument will be dump filename.

ipv4_only.description: Force IPv4 usage (overrides default IPv6 preference).

verbose.description: Verbosity level; value determines number of -v flags.

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for daemonized instance.
